options.content:
SolarWinds Command Center

Real-time Infrastructure Observability • SQL Direct Access

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(NodeID) 
FROM Nodes 
WHERE Status <> 3 /* Exclude Unmanaged */

SELECT AVG(AvgResponseTime)
FROM Nodes
WHERE AvgResponseTime > 0 AND Status = 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Region)
FROM Nodes
WHERE Region IS NOT NULL 
  AND Region <> ''
  AND (Status = 2 OR ChildStatus = 2 OR Status = 9 OR ChildStatus = 9)

SELECT 
    (CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) / CAST(NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS FLOAT)) * 100 
FROM Nodes 
WHERE Status <> 3 /* Exclude Unmanaged */

SELECT COUNT(AA.AlertActiveID) 
FROM AlertActive AA
INNER JOIN AlertObjects AO ON AA.AlertObjectID = AO.AlertObjectID
INNER JOIN AlertConfigurations AC ON AO.AlertID = AC.AlertID
WHERE AC.Severity = 2

WITH LatestResponse AS (
    SELECT 
        NodeID, 
        ResponseTime, 
        PercentLoss,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY NodeID ORDER BY [Timestamp] DESC) as Rnk
    FROM ResponseTime_CS_Detail_hist
),
NodeIssues AS (
    SELECT 
        n.NodeID,
        CASE 
            WHEN n.Status = 2 THEN 'Node Down'
            WHEN n.Status = 14 THEN 'Node Critical'
            WHEN n.Status = 3 THEN 'Node Warning'
            WHEN i.DownInt > 0 THEN 'Interface(s) Down'
            WHEN v.DownVol > 0 THEN 'Volume(s) Down/Full'
            WHEN lr.PercentLoss > 10 THEN 'High Packet Loss'
            WHEN lr.ResponseTime > 500 THEN 'High Latency'
            ELSE 'Healthy/Other'
        END AS IssueCategory
    FROM NodesData n
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT NodeID, COUNT(*) as DownInt 
        FROM Interfaces 
        WHERE Status = 2 
        GROUP BY NodeID
    ) i ON n.NodeID = i.NodeID
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT NodeID, COUNT(*) as DownVol 
        FROM Volumes 
        WHERE Status IN (2, 3, 14) 
        GROUP BY NodeID
    ) v ON n.NodeID = v.NodeID
    LEFT JOIN LatestResponse lr ON n.NodeID = lr.NodeID AND lr.Rnk = 1
    WHERE n.Status NOT IN (9, 11)
)
SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN IssueCategory = 'Node Down' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS [Node Down],
    SUM(CASE WHEN IssueCategory = 'Node Critical' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS [Node Critical],
    SUM(CASE WHEN IssueCategory = 'Node Warning' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS [Node Warning],
    SUM(CASE WHEN IssueCategory = 'Interface(s) Down' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS [Interfaces Down],
    SUM(CASE WHEN IssueCategory = 'Volume(s) Down/Full' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS [Volumes Down/Full],
    SUM(CASE WHEN IssueCategory = 'High Packet Loss' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS [High Packet Loss],
    SUM(CASE WHEN IssueCategory = 'High Latency' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS [High Latency]
FROM NodeIssues;

WITH RegionMapping AS (
    SELECT 
        CASE 
            WHEN CP.Region LIKE '%UAE%' 
              OR CP.Location_Code LIKE 'ABD%' OR N.Caption LIKE 'ABD%'
              OR CP.Location_Code LIKE 'DXB%' OR N.Caption LIKE 'DXB%'
              OR CP.Location_Code LIKE 'DFC%' OR N.Caption LIKE 'DFC%'
              OR CP.Location_Code LIKE 'ALN%' OR N.Caption LIKE 'ALN%'
              OR CP.Location_Code LIKE 'SHJ%' OR N.Caption LIKE 'SHJ%'
              OR CP.Location_Code LIKE 'RAK%' OR N.Caption LIKE 'RAK%'
              OR CP.Location_Code LIKE 'AJM%' OR N.Caption LIKE 'AJM%'
              OR CP.Location_Code LIKE 'FUJ%' OR N.Caption LIKE 'FUJ%'
              OR N.Caption LIKE 'mss-al%' 
              OR N.Caption LIKE 'AE%' OR N.Caption LIKE 'ae%' THEN 'UAE'
            WHEN CP.Location_Code LIKE 'KSA%' OR N.Caption LIKE 'KSA%' THEN 'Saudi Arabia'
            WHEN CP.Location_Code LIKE 'PAK%' OR N.Caption LIKE 'PAK%' THEN 'Pakistan'
            WHEN CP.Location_Code LIKE 'QAT%' OR N.Caption LIKE 'QAT%' OR N.Caption LIKE 'qat%' THEN 'Qatar'
            WHEN CP.Location_Code LIKE 'OMN%' OR CP.Location_Code LIKE 'MUS%' OR N.Caption LIKE 'OMN%' OR N.Caption LIKE 'MUS%' THEN 'Oman'
            WHEN CP.Location_Code LIKE 'BAH%' OR N.Caption LIKE 'BAH%' THEN 'Bahrain'
            WHEN CP.Location_Code LIKE 'KWT%' OR N.Caption LIKE 'KWT%' OR N.Caption LIKE 'Kuwait%' THEN 'Kuwait'
            WHEN CP.Location_Code LIKE 'IND%' OR N.Caption LIKE 'IND%' THEN 'India'
            WHEN CP.Location_Code LIKE 'LKA%' OR N.Caption LIKE 'LKA%' THEN 'Sri Lanka'
            WHEN CP.Location_Code LIKE 'EGY%' OR N.Caption LIKE 'EGY%' THEN 'Egypt'
            WHEN CP.Location_Code LIKE 'SGP%' OR N.Caption LIKE 'SGP%' THEN 'Singapore'
            WHEN CP.Location_Code LIKE 'HKG%' OR N.Caption LIKE 'HKG%' THEN 'Hong Kong'
            WHEN CP.Location_Code LIKE 'KE%'   OR N.Caption LIKE 'KE%'   THEN 'Kenya'
            WHEN CP.Region IS NOT NULL AND CP.Region NOT IN ('', 'Global') THEN CP.Region
            WHEN N.Caption LIKE 'Azure%' THEN 'Cloud (Azure)'
            ELSE 'Other'
        END AS [Region]
    FROM dbo.NodesData AS N
    LEFT JOIN dbo.NodesCustomProperties AS CP ON N.NodeID = CP.NodeID
    WHERE N.Status = 2
)
SELECT Region, COUNT(*) as [Down]
FROM RegionMapping
GROUP BY Region
ORDER BY [Down] DESC;

WITH LatestLoss AS (
    SELECT NodeID, PercentLoss,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY NodeID ORDER BY Timestamp DESC) as Rnk
    FROM ResponseTime_CS_Detail_hist
),
InterfaceIssues AS (
    SELECT NodeID, COUNT(*) as DownInt FROM Interfaces WHERE Status = 2 GROUP BY NodeID
),
RegionMapping AS (
    SELECT 
        CASE 
            WHEN CP.Region LIKE '%UAE%' 
              OR CP.Location_Code LIKE 'ABD%' OR N.Caption LIKE 'ABD%'
              OR CP.Location_Code LIKE 'DXB%' OR N.Caption LIKE 'DXB%'
              OR CP.Location_Code LIKE 'DFC%' OR N.Caption LIKE 'DFC%'
              OR CP.Location_Code LIKE 'ALN%' OR N.Caption LIKE 'ALN%'
              OR CP.Location_Code LIKE 'SHJ%' OR N.Caption LIKE 'SHJ%'
              OR CP.Location_Code LIKE 'RAK%' OR N.Caption LIKE 'RAK%'
              OR CP.Location_Code LIKE 'AJM%' OR N.Caption LIKE 'AJM%'
              OR CP.Location_Code LIKE 'FUJ%' OR N.Caption LIKE 'FUJ%'
              OR N.Caption LIKE 'mss-al%' 
              OR N.Caption LIKE 'AE%' OR N.Caption LIKE 'ae%' THEN 'UAE'
            WHEN CP.Location_Code LIKE 'KSA%' OR N.Caption LIKE 'KSA%' THEN 'Saudi Arabia'
            WHEN CP.Location_Code LIKE 'PAK%' OR N.Caption LIKE 'PAK%' THEN 'Pakistan'
            WHEN CP.Location_Code LIKE 'QAT%' OR N.Caption LIKE 'QAT%' OR N.Caption LIKE 'qat%' THEN 'Qatar'
            WHEN CP.Location_Code LIKE 'OMN%' OR CP.Location_Code LIKE 'MUS%' OR N.Caption LIKE 'OMN%' OR N.Caption LIKE 'MUS%' THEN 'Oman'
            WHEN CP.Location_Code LIKE 'BAH%' OR N.Caption LIKE 'BAH%' THEN 'Bahrain'
            WHEN CP.Location_Code LIKE 'KWT%' OR CP.Location_Code LIKE 'Kuwait%' OR N.Caption LIKE 'KWT%' OR N.Caption LIKE 'Kuwait%' THEN 'Kuwait'
            WHEN CP.Location_Code LIKE 'IND%' OR N.Caption LIKE 'IND%' THEN 'India'
            WHEN CP.Location_Code LIKE 'LKA%' OR N.Caption LIKE 'LKA%' THEN 'Sri Lanka'
            WHEN CP.Location_Code LIKE 'EGY%' OR N.Caption LIKE 'EGY%' THEN 'Egypt'
            WHEN CP.Location_Code LIKE 'SGP%' OR N.Caption LIKE 'SGP%' THEN 'Singapore'
            WHEN CP.Location_Code LIKE 'HKG%' OR N.Caption LIKE 'HKG%' THEN 'Hong Kong'
            WHEN CP.Location_Code LIKE 'KE%'   OR N.Caption LIKE 'KE%'   THEN 'Kenya'
            ELSE 'Other'
        END AS [Region],
        N.NodeID, N.Status
    FROM dbo.NodesData AS N
    LEFT JOIN dbo.NodesCustomProperties AS CP ON N.NodeID = CP.NodeID
    WHERE N.Status NOT IN (9, 11)
)
SELECT RM.Region, COUNT(*) as [Warnings]
FROM RegionMapping RM
LEFT JOIN InterfaceIssues i ON RM.NodeID = i.NodeID
LEFT JOIN LatestLoss m ON RM.NodeID = m.NodeID AND m.Rnk = 1
WHERE 
    RM.Status = 3 
    OR (RM.Status = 1 AND (ISNULL(i.DownInt, 0) > 0 OR ISNULL(m.PercentLoss, 0) > 0))
GROUP BY RM.Region
ORDER BY [Warnings] DESC;

SELECT TOP 10
    AC.Name AS [Alert Name],
    COUNT(AH.AlertHistoryID) AS [Trigger Count]
FROM AlertHistory AH
INNER JOIN AlertObjects AO ON AH.AlertObjectID = AO.AlertObjectID
INNER JOIN AlertConfigurations AC ON AO.AlertID = AC.AlertID
WHERE AH.TimeStamp >= DATEADD(day, -30, GETDATE()) 
  AND AH.EventType = 0 -- 0 = Triggered
GROUP BY AC.Name
ORDER BY [Trigger Count] DESC;

SELECT TOP 10 
    Caption AS [Device],
    IP_Address AS [IP],
    CAST(CPULoad AS INT) AS [CPU %],
    CAST(PercentMemoryUsed AS INT) AS [Memory %]
FROM Nodes
WHERE Status = 1 
  AND (CPULoad > 80 OR PercentMemoryUsed > 80) 
ORDER BY CPULoad DESC, PercentMemoryUsed DESC;

Real-time regional health. 
Circle Size = Infrastructure Volume.
Color = Operational Status.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
    Region,
    COUNT(NodeID) as Total_Nodes,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as Nodes_Down,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ChildStatus = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as Children_Down,
    /* SCORING FOR COLOR THRESHOLDS:
       1 = Healthy (Cyan)
       2 = Warning/Child Down (Orange)
       3 = Critical/Main Node Down (Red) 
    */
    CASE 
        WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN Status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 3 
        WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN ChildStatus = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 2 
        ELSE 1 
    END as Region_Status_Code,
    /* Hardcoded Coordinates for Reliability */
    CASE 
        WHEN Region = 'UAE' THEN 25.2048
        WHEN Region = 'Bahrain' THEN 26.0667
        WHEN Region = 'Oman' THEN 21.4735
        WHEN Region = 'Egypt' THEN 26.8206
        WHEN Region = 'Srilanka' THEN 7.8731
        WHEN Region = 'KSA' THEN 23.8859
        WHEN Region = 'Jordan' THEN 30.5852
        WHEN Region = 'Qatar' THEN 25.3548
        WHEN Region = 'Kuwait' THEN 29.3117
        WHEN Region = 'Turkey' THEN 38.9637
        WHEN Region LIKE '%Singapore%' THEN 1.3521

        WHEN Region = 'Uganda' THEN 1.3733

        ELSE 0

        WHEN Region = 'UAE' THEN 55.2708

        WHEN Region = 'Egypt' THEN 30.8025
        WHEN Region = 'Srilanka' THEN 80.7718
        WHEN Region = 'KSA' THEN 45.0792
        WHEN Region = 'Jordan' THEN 36.2384
        WHEN Region = 'Qatar' THEN 51.1839
        WHEN Region = 'Kuwait' THEN 47.4818
        WHEN Region = 'Turkey' THEN 35.2433
        WHEN Region LIKE '%Singapore%' THEN 103.8198
        WHEN Region = 'Hong Kong' THEN 114.1694
        WHEN Region = 'Thailand' THEN 100.9925
        WHEN Region = 'Kenya' THEN 37.9062
        WHEN Region = 'Uganda' THEN 32.2903
        WHEN Region = 'IND' THEN 78.9629
        WHEN Region = 'Pakistan' THEN 69.3451
        ELSE 0
    END AS longitude
FROM Nodes
WHERE Region IS NOT NULL AND Region <> ''
GROUP BY Region

panels.title: 🌍 Global Infrastructure Status

panels.description: Stacked bars showing total impacted nodes per vendor.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
    Vendor,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Nodes_Critical_Down,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Status = 1 AND ChildStatus = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Nodes_Degraded_Children
FROM Nodes
WHERE Vendor IS NOT NULL 
  AND Vendor <> 'Unknown'
  AND (Status = 2 OR ChildStatus = 2) /* Filter to show only impacted nodes */
GROUP BY Vendor
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN Status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 OR SUM(CASE WHEN Status = 1 AND ChildStatus = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
ORDER BY Nodes_Critical_Down DESC, Nodes_Degraded_Children DESC

SELECT TOP 50
      Caption AS NodeName
    , CPULoad AS CPU
    , PercentMemoryUsed AS Memory
    , PercentLoss
    , Status
    , StatusDescription
FROM [dbo].[Nodes]
WHERE Status NOT IN (1, 11, 9) -- 1=Up, 11=External, 9=Unmanaged
ORDER BY CPULoad DESC;

panels.title: Location Health

targets.rawSql:
WITH LatestMetrics AS (
    SELECT NodeID, ResponseTime, PercentLoss,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY NodeID ORDER BY Timestamp DESC) as Rank
    FROM ResponseTime_CS_Detail_hist
),
InterfaceIssues AS (
    SELECT NodeID, COUNT(InterfaceID) as DownInt FROM Interfaces WHERE Status = 2 GROUP BY NodeID
)
SELECT
    n.Caption AS [NODE],
    ISNULL(CAST(cp.Site_ID AS NVARCHAR(100)), 'N/A') AS [SITE],
    CASE 
        WHEN RTRIM(n.Status) = '2' THEN 'DOWN'
        WHEN RTRIM(n.Status) = '14' THEN 'CRITICAL'
        WHEN RTRIM(n.Status) = '3' THEN 'WARNING'
        WHEN RTRIM(n.Status) = '1' AND (ISNULL(i.DownInt, 0) > 0 OR ISNULL(m.PercentLoss, 0) > 0) THEN 'DEGRADED'
        ELSE 'OTHER'
    END AS [HEALTH_STATE],
    ISNULL(CAST(m.ResponseTime AS VARCHAR) + ' ms', 'N/A') AS [RESPONSE TIME],
    ISNULL(m.PercentLoss, 0) AS [PERCENT LOSS],
    ISNULL(i.DownInt, 0) AS [DOWN INT],
    CAST(n.Description AS NVARCHAR(250)) AS [DESCRIPTION]
FROM NodesData n
LEFT JOIN NodesCustomProperties cp ON n.NodeID = cp.NodeID
LEFT JOIN LatestMetrics m ON n.NodeID = m.NodeID AND m.Rank = 1
LEFT JOIN InterfaceIssues i ON n.NodeID = i.NodeID
WHERE 
    (n.Status NOT IN ('1', '9', '11')) -- Capture all non-UP nodes
    OR (n.Status = '1' AND (ISNULL(i.DownInt, 0) > 0 OR ISNULL(m.PercentLoss, 0) > 0)) -- Capture UP but Broken
ORDER BY CASE WHEN n.Status = '2' THEN 0 WHEN n.Status = '14' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, m.PercentLoss DESC;

WITH LatestMetrics AS (
    SELECT NodeID, PercentLoss,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY NodeID ORDER BY Timestamp DESC) as Rank
    FROM ResponseTime_CS_Detail_hist
),
InterfaceIssues AS (
    SELECT NodeID, COUNT(InterfaceID) as DownInt FROM Interfaces WHERE Status = 2 GROUP BY NodeID
),
RegionMapping AS (
    SELECT 
        CASE 
            WHEN CP.Region LIKE '%UAE%' 
              OR CP.Location_Code LIKE 'ABD%' OR N.Caption LIKE 'ABD%'
              OR CP.Location_Code LIKE 'DXB%' OR N.Caption LIKE 'DXB%'
              OR CP.Location_Code LIKE 'DFC%' OR N.Caption LIKE 'DFC%'
              OR CP.Location_Code LIKE 'ALN%' OR N.Caption LIKE 'ALN%'
              OR CP.Location_Code LIKE 'SHJ%' OR N.Caption LIKE 'SHJ%'
              OR CP.Location_Code LIKE 'RAK%' OR N.Caption LIKE 'RAK%'
              OR CP.Location_Code LIKE 'AJM%' OR N.Caption LIKE 'AJM%'
              OR CP.Location_Code LIKE 'FUJ%' OR N.Caption LIKE 'FUJ%'
              OR N.Caption LIKE 'mss-al%' 
              OR N.Caption LIKE 'AE%' OR N.Caption LIKE 'ae%' THEN 'UAE'
            WHEN CP.Location_Code LIKE 'KSA%' OR N.Caption LIKE 'KSA%' THEN 'Saudi Arabia'
            WHEN CP.Location_Code LIKE 'PAK%' OR N.Caption LIKE 'PAK%' THEN 'Pakistan'
            WHEN CP.Location_Code LIKE 'QAT%' OR N.Caption LIKE 'QAT%' OR N.Caption LIKE 'qat%' THEN 'Qatar'
            WHEN CP.Location_Code LIKE 'OMN%' OR CP.Location_Code LIKE 'MUS%' OR N.Caption LIKE 'OMN%' OR N.Caption LIKE 'MUS%' THEN 'Oman'
            WHEN CP.Location_Code LIKE 'BAH%' OR N.Caption LIKE 'BAH%' THEN 'Bahrain'
            WHEN CP.Location_Code LIKE 'KWT%' OR N.Caption LIKE 'KWT%' OR N.Caption LIKE 'Kuwait%' OR N.Caption LIKE 'KWT%' THEN 'Kuwait'
            WHEN CP.Location_Code LIKE 'IND%' OR N.Caption LIKE 'IND%' THEN 'India'
            WHEN CP.Location_Code LIKE 'LKA%' OR N.Caption LIKE 'LKA%' THEN 'Sri Lanka'
            WHEN CP.Location_Code LIKE 'EGY%' OR N.Caption LIKE 'EGY%' THEN 'Egypt'
            WHEN CP.Location_Code LIKE 'SGP%' OR N.Caption LIKE 'SGP%' THEN 'Singapore'
            WHEN CP.Location_Code LIKE 'HKG%' OR N.Caption LIKE 'HKG%' THEN 'Hong Kong'
            WHEN CP.Location_Code LIKE 'KE%'   OR N.Caption LIKE 'KE%'   THEN 'Kenya'
            ELSE 'Other' 
        END AS [Region],
        N.NodeID, N.Status
    FROM dbo.NodesData AS N
    LEFT JOIN dbo.NodesCustomProperties AS CP ON N.NodeID = CP.NodeID
    WHERE N.Status <> 9
)
SELECT 
    Region,
    SUM(CASE WHEN RTRIM(Status) = '1' AND ISNULL(i.DownInt, 0) = 0 AND ISNULL(m.PercentLoss, 0) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS [Up],
    SUM(CASE WHEN RTRIM(Status) = '1' AND (ISNULL(i.DownInt, 0) > 0 OR ISNULL(m.PercentLoss, 0) > 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS [Degraded],
    SUM(CASE WHEN RTRIM(Status) = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS [Down],
    SUM(CASE WHEN RTRIM(Status) NOT IN ('1', '2') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS [Warning]
FROM RegionMapping RM
LEFT JOIN LatestMetrics m ON RM.NodeID = m.NodeID AND m.Rank = 1
LEFT JOIN InterfaceIssues i ON RM.NodeID = i.NodeID
GROUP BY Region
ORDER BY [Down] DESC;

panels.description: Critical alerts that have NOT been acknowledged. Zero Inbox policy applies.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT TOP 50
    AC.Name AS [Alert Name],
    AO.EntityCaption AS [Object],
    DateDiff(minute, AA.TriggeredDateTime, GETDATE()) as [MinutesActive]
FROM AlertActive AA
INNER JOIN AlertObjects AO ON AA.AlertObjectID = AO.AlertObjectID
INNER JOIN AlertConfigurations AC ON AO.AlertID = AC.AlertID
WHERE 
    AC.Severity = 2 -- Critical Only
    AND ISNULL(AA.Acknowledged, 0) = 0 -- FIX: Treat NULL as Unacknowledged
ORDER BY AA.TriggeredDateTime DESC;

panels.description: High Speed Interfaces (>1Gbps) or Core/Uplink links that are DOWN.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT TOP 50 
    N.Caption AS NodeName,
    I.Caption AS InterfaceName
FROM Interfaces I
INNER JOIN NodesData N ON I.NodeID = N.NodeID
WHERE 
    I.Status = 2 -- Down
    AND N.Status != 9 -- Node is not Unmanaged
    AND (
        I.InterfaceSpeed >= 1000000000 -- 1Gbps+
        OR I.Caption LIKE '%Uplink%' 
        OR I.Caption LIKE '%Core%' 
        OR I.Caption LIKE '%Tunnel%'
        OR I.InterfaceAlias LIKE '%Backbone%'
        OR I.InterfaceAlias LIKE '%Transit%'
    );

panels.title: ✂️ Down Core Interfaces

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  Vendor AS metric,
  COUNT(n.NodeID) AS value
FROM NodesData n
JOIN NodesCustomProperties cp ON n.NodeID = cp.NodeID
GROUP BY Vendor

panels.description: Nodes that are actively DOWN (Excluding Unmanaged/External).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT TOP 50 
    N.Caption AS NodeName,
    N.IP_Address,
    N.Status
FROM NodesData N
WHERE N.Status NOT IN (1, 9, 11) -- Exclude Up, Unmanaged, External
ORDER BY N.Status ASC;

panels.title: 💀 Nodes with Problems (Status != Up)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT TOP 50
    N.Caption AS NodeName,
    H.UniqueName AS Sensor,
    H.Value,
    H.Unit,
    H.Message
FROM HWH_HardwareItem H
INNER JOIN NodesData N ON H.HardwareInfoID = N.NodeID 
WHERE H.Status NOT IN (1, 0, 27) -- Exclude Normal, Unknown, Disabled
ORDER BY H.Status DESC;

SELECT 
    S.ServiceName,
    COUNT(SA.ProbeID) as Probes,
    MAX(SA.LastStatus) as Status
FROM NetPath_EndpointServices S
JOIN NetPath_EndpointServiceAssignments SA ON S.EndpointServiceID = SA.EndpointServiceID
GROUP BY S.ServiceName;

SELECT TOP 20
    N.Caption AS NodeName,
    V.Caption AS Drive,
    V.VolumePercentUsed
FROM Volumes V
INNER JOIN NodesData N ON V.NodeID = N.NodeID
WHERE 
    V.VolumeType = 'Fixed Disk' 
    AND V.VolumePercentUsed > 90 
ORDER BY V.VolumePercentUsed DESC;

SELECT TOP 50
      n.Caption AS NodeName
    , v.Caption AS VolumeName
    , v.Status
    , v.VolumeType
    , v.VolumePercentUsed
FROM [dbo].[Volumes] v
INNER JOIN [dbo].[Nodes] n ON v.NodeID = n.NodeID
WHERE v.VolumeType IN ('Fixed Disk', 'Mount Point', 'Network Disk')
  AND v.Status <> 1 -- 1 = Up
ORDER BY v.VolumePercentUsed DESC;
